label: POST-FREEZE demo case: a quiet bank-detail change on a photographed invoice. Fictional vendor, synthetic numbers.
email:
From: accounts@coastallogistics.co.in
Subject: Invoice for October freight

Hi team,
Please find attached our invoice for the October FTL run. Kindly process at the earliest.

Regards,
Accounts, Coastal Logistics

arguments.reason: Invoice CL/26-27/705 dated 15-10-2026 for Rs 86,376.00 contains a note that bank details have changed w.e.f. 01-10-2026 to a new Yes Bank account 69420333082033 (YESB0913281). Change of beneficiary bank details via invoice note/email attachment is a high-risk fraud vector and has not been independently verified via a trusted channel. Additionally GSTIN 37ZZAFC5390B1Z0 (state code 37 - Andhra Pradesh) is inconsistent with the vendor address shown as Gujarat (state code 24), requiring clarification. Payment held for human verification of bank details and GSTIN with vendor through known contact before transfer.
